# JourneyScope

> Runtime debugging SDK for Kotlin Multiplatform apps (Android, iOS). Records the whole journey of an operation (UI → ViewModel → UseCase → Repository → Network → Database → UI state), shows it in an in-app Compose inspector, and exports redacted reports. Pre-release (0.2.0); publish locally with `./gradlew publishToMavenLocal`.

Instructions for AI agents installing and instrumenting JourneyScope in a host app. Read the playbook first.

## Start here

- [Setup playbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mandanai/devscope-compose/main/ai/setup-playbook.md): end-to-end install, configure, instrument, verify procedure
- [Decision tree](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mandanai/devscope-compose/main/ai/decision-tree.md): project signals to modules and scenarios
- [Guardrails](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mandanai/devscope-compose/main/ai/guardrails.md): privacy, release-safety and API-misuse rules
- [Verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mandanai/devscope-compose/main/ai/verification.md): how to prove the integration works

## Scenarios

- [Trace a UI-to-repository flow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mandanai/devscope-compose/main/ai/scenarios/trace-usecase-flow.md): journeys and spans
- [Ktor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mandanai/devscope-compose/main/ai/scenarios/network-ktor.md): network tracing plugin
- [OkHttp / Retrofit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mandanai/devscope-compose/main/ai/scenarios/network-okhttp.md): interceptor and request tagging
- [Flow and StateFlow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mandanai/devscope-compose/main/ai/scenarios/flow-state.md): state and coroutine tracing
- [Navigation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mandanai/devscope-compose/main/ai/scenarios/navigation.md): NavigationTracer
- [SQLDelight](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mandanai/devscope-compose/main/ai/scenarios/database-sqldelight.md): database spans
- [Expected sequences](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mandanai/devscope-compose/main/ai/scenarios/expected-sequence.md): declared step checks
- [Export and history](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mandanai/devscope-compose/main/ai/scenarios/export-history.md): redacted persistence and sharing
- [Release safety](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mandanai/devscope-compose/main/ai/scenarios/release-safety.md): keep debug tooling out of release
